heroText: The system aims to manage the financial and administrative operations of the religious tourism company in an integrated manner.
homeSection_1: The system enables the management of an integrated database for all clients and service beneficiaries—whether they have already made a booking or have yet to do so. It records client data, tracks their financial and administrative status, and links them to bookings, receipts, and various reports.
homeSection_2: Responsible for managing all financial transactions within the company—including revenue, expenses, and bank and cash balances—as well as issuing customer receipts.
umreSection_1: The system enables the management of flexible and constantly updated tourism price offers, with the ability to link prices to specific trips or seasons.
financeSystemCardData: Bank Account Management
Ability to add multiple bank accounts, including bank details (name, account number, currency, notes)
View the current balance for each account
Automatic balance updates upon issuing a receipt linked to the account
Record manual deposits or withdrawals (internal transfers or bank charges)
View detailed reports on account transactions over a specific period (date, transaction type, amount, user)
Cash Vault/Till Management
Defining company cash vaults/tills (e.g., head office vault, branch till, supervisor's till)
Entering opening balances
Recording daily cash receipts and disbursements
Updating balances in real-time after every transaction
Generating cash vault movement reports detailing all transactions within a specific period
Receipts
Generate a receipt when: a customer makes a cash payment at the company premises

Receipt details include: receipt number and date; customer name and contact number; amount and payment method (transfer or cash); name of the bank or cash fund where the amount was deposited; and the name of the user who issued the receipt

Upon saving the receipt: the balance in the bank account or cash fund is automatically updated; the receipt is linked to the customer to appear in their payment history; and the receipt can be printed in a ready-to-use format stamped with the company logo
Simplified Financial Entries:
Simplified Financial Entries: Operating expenses (rent, electricity, commissions, transportation, etc.) / Internal transfers between banks and cash vaults
Each entry includes: Date - Description - Debit Account - Credit Account - Amount
Company Balances
Real-time view of the balance for each bank and cash fund individually.
View of the company's total aggregate balance (sum of bank accounts + cash funds).
Ability to filter and view balances by date or account type.
crmSystemCardData: Customer source (e.g., online marketing representative, referral, etc.)
Registering a Customer Without a Booking
A new customer can be registered without being linked to a specific trip, allowing their data to be saved for future communication or marketing purposes.
The customer can later be converted into a 'booking customer' once the desired trip is selected.
Customers are categorized within the system into: booking customers and potential customers (those who have not yet booked).
Ability to send marketing offers or automated reminders to these customers.
Link the booking to an existing customer profile without needing to re-enter their data.
Record trip details associated with the customer, such as:
Trip type (domestic tourism, religious tourism, other)
View the history of past and current bookings for each customer
Each receipt is automatically linked to the customer's name.
All receipts and payments associated with the customer appear in their profile.
The most recent payment and its date
The system provides a dedicated page for easily searching and querying customers and bookings using:
Name / Phone Number / Receipt Number / Trip Type
The customer page displays all their details, status, payments, and trip history in one place.
